title: lepisorus perrierianus
intro: Lepisorus perrierianus, commonly known as the Perrier's Cliff Brake, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lepisorus perrierianus include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
